name: Planzer.io API
description:
Read and create tasks in Planzer.io and get notified when tasks are created or completed. Used by the Zapier and Make integrations and available for your own scripts.

Authenticate with a personal API key: create one in Planzer under Settings → Integrations → API keys and send it as `Authorization: Bearer pk_…`. A key gives access to the tasks of the account that created it.

Errors are returned as `{ "error": { "status": 400, "message": "…" } }`. Requests are limited to 120 per minute per API key (per IP address for requests without a valid key); over the limit you get 429 with a `Retry-After` header.
